## Courses

- [AI Engineering from Scratch](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/){.external target='_blank'} — a free open-source course: build the maths and the code first, then the frameworks, from linear algebra to agents.
- [Agentic Engineering 101](https://agenticengineering101.ai/){.external target='_blank'} — a free course on running many AI coding agents at once, and still keeping the quality.
